I managed to get fertilizer through the farm input program this year, so I will apply NPK and urea to this maize plot because it is my main field and needs feeding to produce well. I will plant the hybrid seed that came with the coupon since it works best when there is fertilizer, and my family will do the ridging, planting, and weeding ourselves since the plot is small. We do not use chemicals for pests on maize, and there is no irrigation here in Balaka, so we depend entirely on the rains. I do not plan to hire any ganyu labor because we can manage the work together at home.
